evidence: The Ti–silicate layers were deposited by ALCVD using the liquid precursors tetrakis(diethylamido)titanium [Ti(N(C2H5)2)4] and tetra(butoxyortho)silane [Si(O nC4H9)4]. During the deposition, the pressure and temperature in the chamber were maintained at 0.6 Torr and 200 °C, respectively. The Ar flow rates of Ti(N(C2H5)2)4 and Si(O nC4H9)4 were 15 sccm.
